caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest placed on a light, cream-colored background. The chest is shown in a three-quarters perspective, revealing its front and left side. It is medium brown in color with visible wood grain texture. The chest stands on four round, ball-shaped feet, also brown. Each corner of the chest is reinforced with black metal fittings, including brackets and hinges. There is a black metal handle affixed to the side and visible keyholes on the front, indicating possible locks. On the front and sides, additional metal hardware components are attached for structural support or decorative purposes. The chest has a lid, slightly overhanging the main box body. A thin, brown, hand-drawn rectangular border frames the composition. In the lower right corner, there is a small inset technical sketch showing the chest’s proportions and measurements, viewed from a similar perspective. The artist's signature, "Samuel F. Freeman Del. 1891," is inscribed near the bottom right.
title: Money Chest in Old Swedes Church
